# Distance from Earth to the Sun

The average distance from the Earth to the Sun is approximately:

- **149.6 million kilometers** (149,597,870.7 km)
- **93 million miles**
- **1 Astronomical Unit (AU)** — this distance is actually used as a standard unit of measurement in astronomy

Because Earth's orbit is slightly **elliptical** (not a perfect circle), the distance varies throughout the year:

| Point | Distance |
|---|---|
| **Perihelion** (closest, ~January) | ~147.1 million km |
| **Aphelion** (farthest, ~July) | ~152.1 million km |

Light from the Sun takes about **8 minutes and 20 seconds** to reach Earth.
